purpose: Confirm a fact or concede a point before qualifying it.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
It is certainly cheap, but I am concerned about the quality.
That opinion certainly has some merit.
restrictions: Can strongly affirm or introduce a concession followed by が.
mistake: たしか often means if I remember correctly; 確かに is more definite.

segments.role: Confirm a fact or concede a point before qualifying it. 確かに + claim
